signed_rows.behavior: okf-vs-change matches a stable decision whose file source the change touched
signed_rows.fails_when: the decision is missing from the matched list

signed_rows.behavior: okf-vs-change matches a folder source as a prefix of a changed file
signed_rows.fails_when: a decision whose folder source holds a changed file is missing

signed_rows.behavior: okf-vs-change leaves out draft decisions and URL sources
signed_rows.fails_when: a draft decision or a URL source appears in the matched list

signed_rows.behavior: the matched decisions appear in the task the agent gets
signed_rows.fails_when: the user message does not list the matched decisions

signed_rows.behavior: --audit okf-vs-change without --base exits 2 with a message naming --base
signed_rows.fails_when: it exits other than 2 or the message does not name --base

signed_rows.behavior: okf-vs-change is in AUDITS and in run --help
signed_rows.fails_when: AUDITS or --help lacks okf-vs-change

signed_rows.behavior: with --instructions-root DIR, a tracked relative --prompt-file, --system-prompt-file, --context and --skills resolve under DIR
signed_rows.fails_when: any of them resolves against the current folder

signed_rows.behavior: with --instructions-root DIR, a --context folder git does not track stays in the working tree
signed_rows.fails_when: the untracked folder is looked up under DIR or dropped

signed_rows.behavior: without --instructions-root, every path resolves as before
signed_rows.fails_when: a path resolves differently without the flag

signed_rows.behavior: the action's event check lets workflow_dispatch, schedule and a same-repository pull_request run
signed_rows.fails_when: any of them is refused

signed_rows.behavior: a fork pull_request, or one Dependabot opened, gets a notice, exit 0, and a step output that skips the agent step
signed_rows.fails_when: the step exits nonzero, prints no notice, or sets no output that keeps the agent step from running

signed_rows.behavior: pull_request_target, push and other events stay refused
signed_rows.fails_when: any of them is let through

signed_rows.behavior: the agent step passes --instructions-root and --base only on a pull_request event
signed_rows.fails_when: they are passed on another event or missing on a pull request

signed_rows.behavior: publish --pr N creates one marked comment, and a second run edits that comment and posts no other
signed_rows.fails_when: the second run posts a new comment or edits none

signed_rows.behavior: publish with no report posts nothing and exits 0, in issue and pull request mode
signed_rows.fails_when: it exits nonzero or calls gh

signed_rows.behavior: the action's publish step passes --pr on a pull_request event
signed_rows.fails_when: --pr is missing on a pull request or passed on another event

signed_rows.behavior: ADR 0005 and ADR 0017 each have a dated Correction linking ADR 0057
signed_rows.fails_when: either record lacks a Correction section that links 0057
signed_rows.command: for f in .okf/decisions/0005-audits-report-only.md .okf/decisions/0017-the-ci-audit-is-a-standalone-pydanticai-agent-script.md; do awk '/^## Correction, 2026-/{c=1} c' "$f" | grep -q '0057-the-audit-runs-on-a-pull-request' || exit 1; done

signed_rows.behavior: the knowledge-audit workflow no longer says the audit never runs on a pull request
signed_rows.fails_when: the comment still says it never runs on a pull request

signed_rows.behavior: the how-to page shows a pull request workflow with the same-repository condition
signed_rows.fails_when: the page has no head.repo.full_name condition

signed_rows.behavior: the okf-vs-change prompt keeps the audit report-only, needs only the read, search and list tools, and asks for a reason for each decision the agent adds beyond the matched list
signed_rows.fails_when: a reviewer finds the prompt lets the agent edit files, relies on run_shell or a skill's scripts, or lets it add decisions without a reason

signed_rows.behavior: the repo's pre-commit hooks pass on every file
signed_rows.fails_when: prek run --all-files exits nonzero

signed_rows.behavior: the action's publish mode does not fail on a missing report artifact
signed_rows.fails_when: a missing artifact fails the publish step

signed_rows.behavior: the knowledge-audit workflow's report download does not fail publish on a missing artifact
signed_rows.fails_when: the download-artifact step in the publish job lacks continue-on-error: true
signed_rows.command: awk '/^  publish:/{p=1} p' .github/workflows/knowledge-audit.yml | grep -A4 'actions/download-artifact' | grep -q 'continue-on-error: true'

signed_rows.behavior: with --instructions-root DIR, an instruction path the pull request tracks but DIR does not have exits 2
signed_rows.fails_when: it falls back to the working tree or exits other than 2

signed_rows.behavior: with --no-shell the agent's tools leave out run_shell and the system prompt does not offer it; without the flag nothing changes
signed_rows.fails_when: run_shell is among the tools or named in the system prompt under --no-shell, or missing without it

signed_rows.behavior: the action's agent step passes --no-shell only on a pull_request event
signed_rows.fails_when: --no-shell is missing on a pull request or passed on another event
